info.name: ExamLens API
info.description:
ExamLens public API (/api/v1). Run in order: Register (or Login) stores {{accessToken}}; the refresh token lives in an httpOnly cookie.

CLI: `npx newman run postman/ExamLens.postman_collection.json` from the repo root (file uploads use paths relative to the repo root).

request.description: Uses the refreshToken cookie. Returns a new access token and replaces the cookie; the old refresh token stops working.

exec: pm.test('contains created space with documentCount', () => { const s = pm.response.json().spaces.find(x => x._id === pm.collectionVariables.get('spaceId')); pm.expect(s).to.exist; pm.expect(s.documentCount).to.eql(0); });
pm.test('year is null for notes', () => pm.expect(d.year).to.eql(null));

request.description: A text file renamed to .pdf: rejected by the %PDF- magic-bytes check.
Polls (like the app does) until no document is queued/processing. Needs the AI service + Ollama running.

exec: pm.test('notes PDF is ready', () => pm.expect(docs.find(d => d._id === pm.collectionVariables.get('docId')).status).to.eql('ready'));

request.description: Retry only works for failed documents (or ones stuck for 10+ minutes).
Server-Sent Events: `event: token` {text} repeated, then `event: done` {citations, messageId}. Postman shows the raw stream.

exec: pm.test('streams tokens then done', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(t).to.include('event: token'); pm.expect(t).to.include('event: done'); });

request.description: Questions behind one heatmap cell. Filters: topic=<topicId|none>, year=YYYY.
Matches below the confidence threshold (0.65) that the student should review.

exec: pm.test('all flagged low confidence', () => pm.response.json().questions.forEach(q => pm.expect(q.lowConfidence).to.be.true));

request.description: Body { topicId: "<topic id>" | null }. Moves a question to another topic by hand; automatic re-matching then leaves it alone.
Only the AI service may call /internal/*, using the X-Service-Key header.

request.description: Units, topics and every important question with marks, "also asked in" years and whether an answer is cached.

exec: pm.test('8 questions from the fixture', () => pm.expect(b.questions.filter(q => q.unit).length).to.be.at.least(8));
pm.test('units from the UNIT headings', () => pm.expect(b.units.map(u => u.unit)).to.include.members(['Unit 1', 'Unit 2']));
pm.test('marks from the group headings', () => pm.expect(b.questions.find(q => /congestion/i.test(q.text)).marks).to.eql(10));
const bankTopics = pm.response.json().topics; if (bankTopics.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('bankTopicId', bankTopics.at(-1)._id);

request.description: Marks-aware answer from the notes, streamed, then cached as an Answer.

exec: pm.test('streams tokens then done', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(t).to.include('event: token'); pm.expect(t).to.include('event: done'); });
pm.test('done says which model wrote it', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.match(/"provider": ?"(local|cloud)"/));
const a = pm.response.json().answer; pm.test('cached', () => pm.expect(a).to.not.eql(null)); pm.test('2 marks', () => pm.expect(a.marks).to.eql(2));
const j = pm.response.json().job; pm.test('has progress', () => { pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(5); pm.expect(j.done).to.be.at.least(0); });

item.name: Tier 2 (plan, check my answer, revision sheet)

exec: // Local calendar days, as the browser sends them.
const day = (n) => { const d = new Date(Date.now() + n * 86400000); return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`; };
pm.test('no plan before an exam date is set', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().plan).to.equal(null));

item.name: Plan – exam date in the past (400)

request.description: Day-by-day plan until the exam (no LLM). The day before the exam is revision day.

exec: pm.test('the eve is revision day', () => pm.expect(p.days[p.days.length - 1].items.some((i) => i.kind === 'revision')).to.be.true);
// Tick a topic on the LAST study day, so today's items stay unticked (a missed day for the re-plan test).

request.description: Asked for as if it were tomorrow: today's unticked items were missed, so the plan is redone from tomorrow.

exec: pm.test('ticked topic stays out', () => pm.expect(p.days.flatMap((d) => d.items).every((i) => !p.studiedTopics.includes(i.topic))).to.be.true);

request.description: Streams event: grade (estimated marks, breakdown, covered, missing) first, then the full-marks version, then done. Saved as an attempt.

exec: pm.test('grade comes before the improved answer', () => { pm.expect(t).to.include('event: grade'); pm.expect(t.indexOf('event: grade')).to.be.below(t.indexOf('event: token')); });
pm.test('marks breakdown adds up', () => pm.expect(c.breakdown.reduce((s, b) => s + b.got, 0)).to.be.closeTo(c.estimatedMarks, 0.51));
pm.test('done or a clear no-notes error', () => pm.expect(/event: done|no_notes/.test(t)).to.be.true);

item.description: Exam countdown planner, Check my answer and last-night revision sheets. Local mode only (no Cloud quota used).
